thread:
jordan: noticed CI failures after the keystore rotation attempt this morning, SAST jobs failing to fetch decrypted artifacts
jordan: sample error: `ERROR: 403 PermissionDenied: serviceAccount:ci-scanner@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com missing kms.cryptoKeyVersions.useToDecrypt on projects/redwood-prod/.../keystore/cryptoKeys/sast-main`
priya: thanks for the flag. Was the rotation executed by the terraform job or the rotation pipeline?
eli: rotation pipeline ran and created a new cryptoKey resource; terraform later reapplied and replaced the alias resource, so bindings ended up pointing at an old id 
ci-scanner: JOB_FAIL run=ci-sast-main-90211 reason=decrypt_error
ops-oncall: I can apply an emergency grant for 1h to unblock. Need the exact resource name and ticket link
jordan: resource = `projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/keystore/cryptoKeys/sast-main-v2026-04-01` ticket = SEC-4442
ops-oncall: applying: `gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding sast-main-v2026-04-01 --location=global --keyring=keystore --member=serviceAccount:ci-scanner@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com --role=roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter`
ops-oncall: audit: `iam.bind: ops-oncall -> ci-scanner on sast-main-v2026-04-01 (ttl=60m) ticket=SEC-4442`
security-bot: INCIDENT_CREATED: sast-keystore-rotation (sev=medium) owner=eng-security
priya: requeue CI once grant is live, also we need short-term and long-term fixes: short = grant + rerun; long = make rotation idempotent and preserve alias bindings
eli: proposed fixes: 1) rotation pipeline to run `gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy` post-rotation and verify consumer SAs are present; 2) keystore TF should maintain an alias cryptoKey as stable resource and attach bindings to alias; 3) add alert for `SetIamPolicy` removals on keystore resources used by CI SAs
jordan: another problem: partial scan runs produced duplicate findings in triage queue. We should mark aborted/partial runs as `incomplete` so aggregator ignores them
ci-scanner: NOTE: run=2026-04-01T08:12:03Z status=partial_archive mark=incomplete
priya: will update the evidence-collector to filter on `archive_complete=true` before emitting findings. Add unit tests to cover aborted artifacts
eli: I'll add a pre-promotion check in rotation pipeline that fails the promote step unless `iam-sync` confirms bindings for `ci-scanner` and `sast-consumer` groups. Also add a staging dry-run cadence
ops-oncall: grant applied and job requeued: `ci-sast-main-90211` requeued
ci-scanner: JOB_REQUEUED run=ci-sast-main-90211
ci-scanner: JOB_SUCCEEDED run=ci-sast-main-90211 artifacts=ok
jordan: nice. postmortem items: TF alias change, rotation precheck, evidence dedupe, alert rule, and a runbook tweak that mandates a staging dry-run before prod rotation
priya: assigning tasks in ENGSEC board and linking SEC-4442. I'll also add a small `gcloud` snippet to the runbook to validate bindings: `gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy sast-main-v2026-04-01 --location=global --keyring=keystore | grep ci-scanner`
eli: one more: schedule a canary rotation on staging in 3 days and include helm/iam-sync integration test in CI so we catch this earlier :thumbsup:
security-bot: SUGGESTION: add alert rule `keystore_binding_removal` to observability, severity=high if applied to prod key used by CI SAs
ops-oncall: ephemeral grant expired, CI remains green. closing temporary unblock
jordan: thanks all, I'll draft the short postmortem and link the infra PRs. closing thread when postmortem is published
